description: The desktop notification Baude posts when a chat finishes a turn or asks you something while you're elsewhere (the system's own banner, not drawn in the window).
opens: a chat's turn ends or it asks a question or needs a permission answer, while its window is not in front or another chat is open

parts.name: Title
parts.shows: The chat's name: for the open chat, the window's title; for a Bot, its name, never its chat's title; for any other chat, its title ("(untitled)" if it has none).

parts.name: Body
parts.shows: What happened: the reply's first words when a turn finishes ("Finished" when there is nothing to say), "Waiting for your answer: <tool>", or "Claude has a question for you".

actions.does: Brings the window up with that chat open (a chat on a host has its transcript fetched first).

states.name: a Bot switched away from, mid-turn
states.shows: Its notification, titled with the Bot's name, when its turn ends or it waits.
